description:
Hello dosto kal mujhe ICICI Lombard se insurance copy mil chuka hai. jise ola app se ja k apne email pe forward kar sakte hain. 
Aj sunday k din mujhe ola se call ata hai Aadhar aur Vahan otp confirmation k liye. sath hi physical signature bhi hogaya hai. Mera Location South east Delhi Near Jamia millia Islamiya hai. lag raha hai delivery jaldi hi milegi.

#OLA #olaelectric #olaev #olas1pro #icicilombard
